Group: AliExpress top-up (second order, not placed yet)
Part: AS5600 magnetic angle sensor board, with its round magnet
Notes: Search: AS5600 magnetic encoder module. It's a small square board (about 23 x 23 mm) that reads the angle of a little round magnet spinning over its chip. The round thing in the photos is that magnet (6 mm across, 2.5 mm thick, magnetised across its face, called diametric), sometimes in a plastic holder. Get the plain board with the magnet. Skip the kits with a second board or bracket, you don't need them. If no magnet is included, add a 6x2.5mm diametric magnet. Only needed if the Aqua ECU doesn't send the angle
